title: Pancakeswap Prediction bot with TradingView signal Integrated
description: Hello everyone. Welcome to my YouTube channel. In this video, I'm happy to present the Pancakeswap Prediction bot with TradingView signal Integrated.  BeatBot is a bot to automate betting on Defi platform Pancakeswap Prediction with TradingView signal Integrated.  You can build multiple betting strategies based on real-time market conditions signals and apply betting strategies.  :backhand index pointing right: Website: https://www.beatbot.io  :rocket::rocket::rocket: :backhand index pointing right: Join our Telegram group: https://t.me/beatbot_prediction_market_bot  :backhand index pointing right: Visit Pancakeswap Prediction markets: https://pancakeswap.finance/prediction  I hope you guys enjoy this video and find it helpful. If you love this video, please be sure to check out my other videos. Please make sure to like and subscribe to our channel for more videos and ring the notification bell :bell: so you can be notified of all future content.   Don’t forget to share with your friends and family. I would love to hear your opinions, so comment down below. Thank you for watching.  :backhand index pointing right:SUBSCRIBE HERE: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCzKvBp5hZrEtXWhC0_rnVuA/?sub_confirmation=1  PancakeSwap is a decentralized exchange developed to facilitate the swapping of BEP-20 tokens. BEP-20 is a Binance token standard that needs to be followed on the Binance Smart Chain. This is an abbreviation that is short for Binance Smart Chain Evolution Proposal.  The bot uses signals from TradingView to predict the price of BNB for Up or Down in PancakeSwap. PancakeSwap is very safe to use in terms of security, it has never been hacked. The only risks to using the PancakeSwap Exchange are related to impermanent loss in farms and the potential for scams.
